title: NEW MSFS 2024 activities! Lufthansa airline rotations & A220 landing challenges
description:
Looking to add purpose, structured airline schedules, and high-stakes touchdown practice to your flight log in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? The Marketplace just expanded with two brand-new activity packages from Perfect Flight—offering two completely different styles of flying. Whether you want to step into the flight deck for official Lufthansa timetable rotations in the Airbus A320neo or test your stick-and-rudder precision in the Airbus A220 across 24 global destinations, this week's drop delivers hours of focused flying!

In this activity breakdown, we organize the latest marketplace arrivals into clear categories to help you decide what's claiming top priority in your flight log:

✈️ COMMERCIAL AIRLINE ROTATIONS
We kick off with Perfect Flight’s 12 Legs DLH Fall 2026 package. Built for the iniBuilds Airbus A320neo V2, this expansion includes an authentic Lufthansa livery alongside 12 scheduled European IFR missions reflecting real-world timetables across Germany, Slovenia, Albania, Slovakia, Poland, Denmark, Belgium, Italy, and France. We inspect the package's immersion features, including distinct tracked flight events, authentic cockpit and ambient audio, comprehensive in-game briefings, and multi-language operational manuals.

🎯 APPROACH & LANDING SKILL CHALLENGES
Ready to sharpen your flare and rollout technique? Perfect Flight presents Advanced Challenges: A220 Landings, featuring 24 handcrafted scenarios positioned across Europe, North America, the Caribbean, Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Oceania. We review the included liveries, regional distribution, and the vital requirement to keep in mind: this package is designed specifically for the Virtualcol A220 series.

Which of these new activities are you loading up first? Flying multi-leg European airline shifts for Lufthansa, or testing your manual handling skills in the A220 landing tests? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you find your next flight adventure in MSFS 2024, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
